#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

class Main {
public:
    class Task {
    public:
        class Maxflow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int t, rev;
                ll cap, f;
                Edge(int t, int rev, ll cap) : t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
            };

            Maxflow(int n) : graph(n) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    graph[i] = vector<Edge>();
                }
            }

            vector<Edge>* graph;

            void addEdge(int s, int t, ll cap) {
                graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, graph[t].size(), cap));
                graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, graph[s].size() - 1, 0));
            }

            bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
                dist[src] = 0;
                vector<int> Q(graph->size());
                int sizeQ = 0;
                Q[sizeQ++] = src;
                for (int i = 0; i < sizeQ; i++) {
                    int u = Q[i];
                    for (Edge& e : graph[u]) {
                        if (dist[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                            dist[e.t] = dist[u] + 1;
                            Q[sizeQ++] = e.t;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return dist[dest] >= 0;
            }

            ll dinicDFS(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, ll f) {
                if (u == dest) return f;
                for (; ptr[u] < graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
                    Edge& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
                    if (dist[e.t] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                        ll df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.t, min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                        if (df > 0) {
                            e.f += df;
                            graph[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                            return df;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }

            ll maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
                ll flow = 0;
                vector<int> dist(graph->size());
                while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
                    vector<int> ptr(graph->size(), 0);
                    while (true) {
                        ll df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
                        if (df == 0) break;
                        flow += df;
                    }
                }
                return flow;
            }
        };

        class MinCostFlowBF {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int to, cap, cost, rev;
                int f;
                Edge(int v, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(v), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev), f(0) {}
            };

            vector<Edge>* graph;

            MinCostFlowBF(int n) : graph(new vector<Edge>[n]) {}

            void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
                graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, cap, cost, graph[t].size()));
                graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, 0, -cost, graph[s].size() - 1));
            }

            void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevnode, vector<int>& prevedge, vector<int>& curflow) {
                int n = graph->size();
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
                dist[s] = 0;
                curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
                vector<bool> inqueue(n, false);
                vector<int> q(n);
                int qt = 0;
                q[qt++] = s;
                for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
                    int u = q[qh % n];
                    inqueue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge& e = graph[u][i];
                        if (e.f >= e.cap)
                            continue;
                        int v = e.to;
                        int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                            dist[v] = ndist;
                            prevnode[v] = u;
                            prevedge[v] = i;
                            curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                            if (!inqueue[v]) {
                                inqueue[v] = true;
                                q[qt++ % n] = v;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
                int n = graph->size();
                vector<int> dist(n);
                vector<int> curflow(n);
                vector<int> prevedge(n);
                vector<int> prevnode(n);

                int flow = 0;
                int flowCost = 0;
                while (flow < maxf) {
                    bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
                    if (dist[t] == INT_MAX)
                        break;
                    int df = min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
                    flow += df;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                        Edge& e = graph[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                        e.f += df;
                        graph[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                        flowCost += df * e.cost;
                    }
                }
                return {flow, flowCost};
            }
        };

        void solve(istream& sc, ostream& pw) {
            int n, m, k, c, d;
            sc >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
            
            vector<int> pos(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                int x;
                sc >> x;
                pos[x - 1]++;
            }
            
            int T = 100;
            MinCostFlowBF mf((T + 1) * n + 2);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (pos[i] > 0)
                    mf.addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int a, b;
                sc >> a >> b;
                a--; b--;
                for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                    int cost = 0;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        cost = l * l * d;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            vector<int> flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * n + 1, k);
            pw << flowAndCost[1] << endl;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    Main::Task t;
    t.solve(cin, cout);

    return 0;
}
